Fixed per user's explicit design direction (non-blocking timer-based retry + graceful degraded UI, not blocking-sleep retries as I first proposed):

1. OTWApp.h/.m: extracted the DB connection/schema-check/creation logic from -initializeDatabase into a new -attemptSchemaInitialization method, and added a databaseSchemaReady BOOL property (starts NO). -initializeDatabase now builds/registers the EOF model (unchanged, still one-time/idempotent) then calls -attemptSchemaInitialization once synchronously. On success, databaseSchemaReady=YES. On failure, databaseSchemaReady stays NO and the method schedules itself to retry in 5s via an NSTimer added through GSWApplication's own -addTimer: (confirmed via GSWeb source that -run pumps the app's own NSRunLoop in NSDefaultRunLoopMode and -addTimer: schedules onto that exact loop/mode with proper locking - so this is non-blocking and self-heals automatically once the DB becomes reachable, without a pod restart). This directly fixes the bug: no more permanent silent failure from a single failed attempt, and no blocking the main thread with a sleep loop (rejected approach).

2. Main.h/.m/.wod/.html: new -isAppReady method ([(OTWApp *)[self application] isDatabaseSchemaReady]), wired via two new WOConditionals (appReady/appNotReady) so Main shows a friendly 'On the Wing will be back soon - enjoy a mindful moment with nature while you wait!' message instead of the normal (partially-broken) UI while the schema isn't ready yet, self-recovering to the normal page once attemptSchemaInitialization succeeds - no pod restart needed either way.

New tests: TestApp.m (databaseSchemaReady get/set), TestMain.m (isAppReady reflects the app's databaseSchemaReady state). Verified: 25/25 XCTest suites (TestApp 11/11, TestMain 8/8, both +1) + 4/4 Jest suites pass in podman.
